tellings.link_reason: Grant Cameron's tape of Pandolfi talking unguardedly matches the recorded Pandolfi remark about a breakthrough letting people go into 'the next world' in the desert and come back, which is in effect portal talk.

plain: Grant Cameron, a researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Ron Pandolfi, who he says has worked at the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, since 1984 and is rumored to brief presidents. According to Cameron, Pandolfi said on a tape that there had been a "breakthrough" in going "into the next world," and that the next time a man called John went to the desert, several of them would go there and come back. Cameron says he found the tape on the internet, that Pandolfi never expected it to become public, and that Pandolfi was clearly talking about portals, doorways to somewhere else.
